issue.title: Bug: [DRH] Tests failing / unintentionally being skipped due to LRH / URH neighbors not being defined in NEIGHBOR_MAPS

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Tests are failing / unintentionally being skipped for DRH topologies because LRH and URH neighbors aren't defined in NEIGHBOR_MAPs

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test, such as everflow, which will fail if topo neighbors are not defined in NEIGHBOR_MAP

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

LRH / URH neighbors defined in NEIGHBOR_MAP to avoid issues
